description: RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.

latest_release.name: RustFS 1.0.4
latest_release.body:
This patch updates certificate verification and bundled trust roots, removes the distrusted emSign ECC Root CA - G3 from container trust stores, and retains the dependency refresh.

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): refresh dependencies and pin Pulsar 6.9.0 by @houseme in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/8923
* fix(test): backport scanner wait correction for 1.0.4 by @overtrue in https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/pull/8930


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rustfs/rustfs/compare/1.0.3...1.0.4

hot_issues.title: SNSD single-disk: recurring 30-70 MB/s background self-reads with zero S3 client traffic saturate the host HDD (1.0.1)
[BUG] 503 SlowDownRead and Readiness Probe Timeout under Concurrent listObjects Storm during Flink Task Initialization (1.0.4)
Restore copy-back exposes completed expiry before metadata finalization
Investigate CI failures in MRF, diagnostics, and scanner restart
Web console (port 9001) and S3 root / both return generic AccessDenied — anonymous internal calls to synthetic login/session buckets are denied
Five-node HTTPS EC:2: restarted nodes return GET 503 after cluster-health probes succeed
Single drive 1.0.4: anonymous memory accumulates across list / PUT / DeleteObjects and is never released, OOM at 1.5 GiB after two rounds
ListObjectVersions omits ETag for multipart-uploaded objects — breaks Veeam VBR 13 configuration backup

detail.readme_excerpt:
[![RustFS](https://repository-images.githubusercontent.com/722597620/0fa936a2-8164-4f53-867f-def4beb64b21)](https://rustfs.com)

RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust.

Getting Started · Docs · Bug reports · Discussions

English | 简体中文 | Deutsch | Español | français | 日本語 | 한국어 | Portuguese | Русский

RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust—one of the most loved programming languages worldwide. RustFS combines the simplicity of MinIO with the memory safety and raw performance of Rust. It offers broad S3 API compatibility for supported features, is completely open-source, and is optimized for data lakes, AI, and big data workloads. Unlike other storage systems, RustFS is released under the permissible Apache 2.0 license, avoiding the restrictions of AGPL.
